comment: SPEC section 8.1 planning figures, to be replaced by a measured pilot. USD per run on Haiku, by scenario. The model ratio scales them (Sonnet is assumed to cost about 3 times Haiku; the Opus ratio is an extra assumption of this file). The estimate printed by a dry run is the figure times the range factors. The per-run cap proposal is 3 times the assumed cost and the suite cap proposal is 1.25 times the approved estimate.
